data.name: Duck Duck Gone
data.detailed_description:
ONE ROOM. ONE DUCK. UP TO EIGHT LIARS.

Everyone gets the same rubber duck. Everyone gets the same room. Somehow, your friends will still walk straight past yours.

PHASE ONE: COMMIT A TINY CRIME

During the private Hide phase, paint your duck to match the room, change its size and squeeze it into the smartest—or most ridiculous—spot you can find. Behind a plant? Under a bench? Sitting openly on a shelf because surely nobody would be that shameless?

There are no bad ideas. Only hiding spots that become public evidence later.

PHASE TWO: BECOME SUSPICIOUS OF FURNITURE

Then everyone searches at once.

Open doors. Check corners. Interrogate innocent houseplants. Find enemy ducks to score points while keeping your own hidden for as long as possible. Proximity voice chat turns every close call into a bluff, a betrayal or a badly suppressed laugh.

CHEAT POLITELY

Splash a rival with an egg. Freeze them just before they reach a suspicious shelf. Drop a decoy duck and watch somebody celebrate finding absolutely nothing.

Each power has one use per match, so waste it responsibly.

THE REVEAL NEVER LIES

When time runs out, the cinematic reveal camera exposes every hiding spot and gives each duck the judgment it deserves.

The obvious duck gets laughed at. The impossible duck becomes a legend. Then everybody demands one more round.

Features

- Online matches for up to 8 players

- Private Hide phases followed by frantic simultaneous searches

- Paint, resize and place the same rubber duck in wildly different ways

- Proximity voice chat for accusations, fake-outs and suspicious silence

- Egg, Freeze and Decoy powers—one use each per match

- Classic, 2v2 Teams and King of the Hill modes

- Bots for practice and filling empty seats

- A cinematic reveal camera that celebrates brilliance and documents embarrassment

- Multiple colorful maps packed with hiding places

Hide it where they will look.

Make them believe it cannot be there.

And when they walk past it, try not to quack.

data.short_description: Hide a rubber duck in plain sight, then hunt down everyone else’s in this chaotic online party game for up to 8 players. Paint it, resize it, fool your friends and pray the reveal camera is kind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Headset with microphone recommended for proximity voice chat
